name: Green Bean Casserole
ingredients: 1½ pounds fresh or frozen green beans (trimmed and halved)
¼ teaspoon sea salt (plus more to taste)
¼ teaspoon freshly ground black pepper
½ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and set a large bowl of ice water nearby. Drop the green beans into the boiling water and blanch for 2 to 4 minutes, or until crisp-tender and bright green. Immediately transfer to the ice water to stop the cooking process. Drain and transfer to a kitchen towel to dry.
Heat the butter in a medium skillet over medium heat. Add the mushrooms and a pinch of salt and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, or until soft. Remove from the pan and set aside.

Wipe out the pan and return it to the stove. Add the cream, broth, soy sauce, mustard, garlic, onion powder, salt, and pepper and whisk to combine. Bring to a simmer over medium heat, then reduce the heat to medium-low to maintain a gentle simmer. Cook for 10 minutes, whisking occasionally, to reduce the cream slightly. The sauce should lightly coat the back of a spoon.

Reduce the heat to low and gradually add the flour, whisking constantly until smooth. Gradually add the cheese, whisking constantly until it melts into the sauce and the sauce is smooth. Remove from the heat. Note: The sauce will taste salty at this point, but it will balance once it’s on the vegetables.
Spread the green beans and mushrooms in a 9x13-inch baking dish. Pour the sauce on top and gently toss to coat the vegetables.

Cover and bake for 20 minutes, or until the sauce is bubbling around the edges. Uncover and sprinkle with the french fried onions. Bake, uncovered, for 10 more minutes, or until the onions are golden brown and the sauce is bubbling.
Remove from the oven and let stand for 15 minutes before serving.
